instruction: Audit current repo, preserve all routes, auth, data, 14-state machine, voice, WebGL scene and camera controls. Implement compatible chrome and shaders in place. Do not rebuild, fake functionality, or display technical parameters in public UI.

references.A: amber particle horizon, dark sparse field
references.C: cobalt glass spheres with pink-blue contained atmosphere and thin orbital rings; PRIMARY

glassSystem.implementation: Accessible DOM with translucent surface layers and pseudo-element specular highlight. Real Three.js mesh only for spatial objects. Never blur text or use overall element opacity.
glassSystem.contrast: Check on brightest live scene and provide solid backing as necessary

webgl.renderer: Preserve installed WebGL/R3F; test WebGPU/TSL separately, never blindly mix effects

atmosphere.pink: reference-only internal tint, not a global UI color

camera.movement: interruptible arc-length spline; quaternion orientation; save and restore pose

media.testCollection: Hotspot_26_media; verify authorized direct source URLs
media.video: VideoTexture only for playable direct video; use YouTube/Vimeo supported player APIs for embeds; never fake play state
media.documents: PDF rasterized textures plus accessible text layer

agent.tour: derive from live UI; no obsolete fixed tour
agent.stop: cancel speech, cues, tour and autonomous camera movement

screens.name: Gate and loader
requirements: use shared liquid glass tokens
detach surfaces by 14px or collapse when no room
retain existing real actions and data
keep real DOM text crisp and WebGL scene unobstructed
voice and touch use same registered actions
test phone, iPad and desktop
